sentences.japanese: その老人は孫をお供に従えていた。
sentences.english: The old man was accompanied by his grandchild.

sentences.japanese: その老人にはいつも孫が同伴している。
sentences.english: The old man is always accompanied by his grandson.

sentences.japanese: その後は、多くの者が老人ホームで暮らすが、そこには子供とか孫が訪ねていくことが出来る。
sentences.english: After that, many live in special homes for the aged where their children and grandchildren can come to visit them.

sentences.japanese: 老人が孫たちに囲まれて座っていた。
sentences.english: An old man sat surrounded by his grandchildren.
They spoke well of their grandson.
